name: 52001 · Dubuque, IA
findings: ZIP 52001 (Dubuque) has 219 nonprofit organizations. 71 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 55 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 52001 (Dubuque) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 52001 (Dubuque) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 38 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 23 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
